service.description: People the user may reach (search#Users) who have an active vault key, by name or username, as options {value (userId), label}; with recoveryHolders, only those who also hold VAULT_RECOVERY through a group, to split a recovery key to (the server refuses any other holder again), and only for a caller who holds VAULT_RECOVERY, who alone makes one: anyone else gets none, so who holds it is not told.

The names of the users the caller's own vault records name (userIds, at most 200): the members of the vaults they are a member of, the signers of those vaults' member lists, the senders of their deliveries, the users whose keys they checked; the makers of the recovery keys not ended, whose keys a manager checks to turn recovery on; their holders only to a caller who holds VAULT_RECOVERY or is a member of a vault whose member list names that recovery key (recovery:id); and to a holder of VAULT_RECOVERY the people of the recoveries. Any other id, and a user the apps' chat-target providers refuse to the caller, is answered as itself, as one with no name.

The user groups that hold VAULT_RECOVERY, which a recovery key may be kept for (its userGroupId), by id or description, as options {value, label}; to a caller who holds VAULT_RECOVERY, who alone makes one, else none.
